_note: Hashes of the design refs that are ACTIVE design authorities — a curated watchlist over an archive (4 guarded of ~361 .html in this directory). Verified on every build:dev / build:prod by scripts/check-design-refs.mjs. `--update` re-records the watchlist and NAMES what changed; enrolling a NEW ref is an explicit act — `--update design-refs/<file>.html` — because a sweep would guard 357 historical refs and make the word 'active' meaningless. Never re-record from a build.
